title: The Wedding
novel:
An old university friend was getting married, and the thick [[invitation|invitation]] card asked Ted to [[RSVP|RSVP]] with the name of his [[plus-one|plus-one]].

He had nobody. So he asked Robin, and pretended it meant nothing.

The [[ceremony|ceremony]] was held in a stone [[chapel|chapel]]. The [[bride|bride]] walked slowly down the [[aisle|aisle]] behind a white [[veil|veil]], holding a [[bouquet|bouquet]] that shook a little in her hands. The [[groom|groom]] wore a [[tuxedo|tuxedo]] one size too small. They spoke their [[vows|vows]] badly and everyone cried anyway.

At the [[reception|reception]], the [[best man|best man]] gave a speech that lasted nine minutes too long, and a [[bridesmaid|bridesmaid]] in a green [[gown|gown]] cried into the [[catering|catering]] table.

Then came trouble. The [[venue|venue]] wanted the rest of the money; the [[banquet|banquet]] was over budget; the couple had already lost their [[deposit|deposit]] on a band that had [[declined|decline]] to come.

Ted spent the evening fixing other people's problems, and cutting names off the [[guest list|guest list]] with a pencil.

Late at night he danced with Robin and thought: one day someone will [[register|register]] my name next to another. Just not yet.

invitation.en: a card or message asking you to come to an event

RSVP.en: to reply to say if you will come or not

plus-one.en: the guest you are allowed to bring with you

ceremony.en: a formal set of actions for a special event

bride.en: a woman on her wedding day

aisle.en: the long path between rows of seats

veil.en: thin cloth that covers a woman's face or hair

groom.en: a man on his wedding day

tuxedo.en: a smart black suit men wear at formal parties

vows.en: the serious promises two people make when they marry

best man.en: the groom's main friend and helper at a wedding

bridesmaid.en: a girl or woman who helps the bride at a wedding

gown.en: a long dress for a special occasion

catering.en: the work of providing food for an event

venue.en: the place where an event happens

deposit.en: money you pay first to hold something for later

guest list.en: the list of people invited to an event

register.en: to write a name on an official list
